reference.title: EDE troubleshooting
reference.shortdesc: When the station initiates an EDE discovery job, the JobService records it in the Job Log. You can review this log and use it in troubleshooting.

section.p: To see the progress of the EDE discovery job, click on the Job Log control near the top of the manager view. This job displays only objects that failed to discover. It also specifies the invalid property due to which the discovery job failed.
